notes.title: The Speedrun Update!
notes.notes:
New Features

 Added a level timer that records your fastest time in each level
 Added a game timer that tracks the pace of your overall run
 Added a scoreboard to the pause menu that shows which levels you’ve completed and the fastest times you’ve achieved on them
 Added a “New Game” button to the pause menu so you can quickly restart your entire run

Bug Fixes/Minor Changes

 Fixed a bug that would cause the game to lock if the player pressed space during a cut scene
 Updated music file with improved mixing
 Buffed Spinning Hammer Barrier in Level Select Dungeon

notes.title: First Patch!
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who downloaded Moto Knight and brought back feedback and bug reports! You guys had a lot of great ideas, and I'm hoping to implement a lot of fun additions - but for now, here are some immediate improvements!

GAMEPLAY

 Removed fall damage
 Launching pads can no longer be activated by passively holding “jump” button

BUG FIXES

 Fixed visual errors on corners of objects
 Fixed camera following into out of bounds regions
 Removed “(DEBUG)” text from gameplay window
 Launch pads cannot be used after death

SUPPORT

 Removed unused assets, reducing overall project size
